findings: Actual live capture window rate fell from 21.9 to 13.3..14.3; not only an EMA artifact.

RKNN call durations do not show a comparable monotonic slowdown; CPU boundary/draw durations increase.
cap_fps is EMA of reciprocal frame intervals; it differs from count/time window rates.
TrialMetrics.finish is called after source close and thread joins; stopped time biases summary rates downward.
Stereo validate/remap still runs before selecting targets, even on empty detections.
